title: Meme Template / Role Mutation Under Reuse

source_refs.author: Limor Shifman and digital-folklore scholarship
source_refs.title: Memes in Digital Culture and participatory template reuse

observed_structure: a recognizable relational template is reused
one role, caption function, or ownership condition changes
the mutation comments on the template's prior circulation
cinematic_affordances: same frame geometry with different status relation
caption rhythm migrating into dialogue or blocking
cultural_scope: time-sensitive internet artifact; provenance and current usage context must be checked
misuse_risks: treating all repetition as meme logic
transferable_structure: a circulating template acquires new meaning when one relational role changes while enough structure remains recognizable
non_transferable_surface: direct duplication of copyrighted meme images, celebrity likenesses, or platform-specific branding
